To evaluate our model, we use three metrics: ROUGE : ROUGE measures Ngram overlap between the reference and the automatically generated summaries. BARTScore : Because ROUGE scores only measure token overlap, other automated metrics have been proposed to evaluate faithfulness more precisely. BARTScore is a transformer-based measure that scores a dialogue and the corresponding automatically generated summary and has been shown to be strongly correlated with human evaluations of faithfulness.
